exposure: Amiel-Tison neurological assessment at 12 months corrected age
outcome: Bayley outcomes (motor, language, cognitive, socio-emotional categories)
cohort: A cohort of 64 preterm infants born between 24 and 34 weeks of gestation were included in the study.
finding: Machine learning analysis identified sepsis as a key predictor for cognitive and motor outcomes, while gestational age, duration of hospitalization, and Apgar score at 5th minute were predictive for language and socio-emotional outcomes.
